balanced.purpose: parallel independent review with deterministic consensus

auto.rule: high risk, evidence conflict, or ML confidence < 0.70 => assurance; medium => balanced; otherwise fast

consensus_controls: Provider majority is advisory only and is not evidence proof
Provider disagreement creates a reconciliation issue
Consensus confidence is capped by provider agreement and evidence-reference agreement
Missing evidence remains missing even when all providers agree
No provider or consensus may override native P6/XER CPM/TIA
No provider or consensus may create contractual entitlement or Engineer determination
efficiency_controls: disk cache keyed by prompt/model hash
